subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should `steipete/bird` remain unavailable, be republished with a valid upstream, be aliased or redirected to Birdclaw, or drive a broader unavailable-skill UX?
rationale: Current main has no Bird payload to patch, the old upstream still returns 404, and Birdclaw is only a plausible replacement until the owner/admin confirms old-slug semantics.

options.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
options.body: Verify upstream intent, then update or republish the skill metadata, keep the old slug hidden/deprecated, or alias only if Birdclaw is confirmed equivalent.

options.title: Keep old slug unavailable
options.body: If Bird was intentionally removed, preserve the current public API 404 behavior and record that production metadata decision before closing.

options.title: Build unavailable-skill UX
options.body: If removed skills should remain user-visible, add a source-backed hidden/deprecated page flow instead of changing this record ad hoc.

recommendation.title: Owner/admin metadata decision
recommendation.body: Verify upstream intent, then update or republish the skill metadata, keep the old slug hidden/deprecated, or alias only if Birdclaw is confirmed equivalent.

likelyOwner.reason: The namespace and likely replacement package are owned under `steipete`, making this the best available owner for the catalog semantics choice.
